name: Campione d'Italia (Italy)
description: Purple field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Campione d'Italia in a yellow baroque cartouche (a snail above a crozier and a sword).
history: Municipal flag of Campione d'Italia, a comune in Lombardy; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Campione d'Italia arms — snail above a crozier and a sword, in a yellow cartouche
